variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body: The project {project} is badly behind schedule. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Construction timetable falls seriously short
variants.body: Construction on {project} is severely delayed. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A project waits beyond its schedule
variants.body: The project {project} has fallen badly behind its schedule. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
